title: A standing wish after a result becomes a proposed watch

turns.say: 다음 주 수요일 저녁 7시 강남 근처 이탈리안 식당 예약 가능한 곳 있어?
괜찮은 데 자리 나면 알려줘. 화요일 저녁까지만.

good_secretary: After answering once, treats the second turn as a standing wish: proposes one watch that checks availability about three times a day (morning, afternoon, evening) until Tuesday evening and tells the owner only when a table opens, phrased as one question, and says exactly what it will check and until when.

title: The request sentence of a standing wish is not saved as a memory

turns.say: 새로 나온 무선 청소기 하나 사려고 하는데 지금 얼마쯤 해?
이번 달 안에 20만원 아래로 내려가면 알려줘.

good_secretary: Proposes a price watch with about three checks a day until the end of the month that reports only when the price drops below the threshold, as one question. Does not store the owner's request sentence as a memory; at most a fact about the owner in their own words.
